title: pleopeltis sinensis
intro: Pleopeltis sinensis, commonly known as Chinese tuckahoe or Chinese spleenwort, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis sinensis include reducing fever, relieving cough and asthma symptoms, and promoting digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
